title: Nine Pages of Describing
subtitle: 情形与境况 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情形与境况（做人与做事·处境与应变）
meta: 主题语境：情形与境况（做人与做事·处境与应变）　|　核心词汇：circumstance　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 circumstance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to describe ① circumstance she could not change, and she said the describing was the whole of the lesson. The ② circumstance, meaning the condition and not the event, was nine pages long and was described by whoever came last; circumstance, she said, is the only thing in a case that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ circumstance in that case had the same witness, and the ④ circumstance at the end, meaning the one the lawyer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described properly. Circumstance, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ circumstance was the whole of the family, meaning the money it carried and not the condition. The ⑥ circumstance, meaning the money and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody notices and nobody questions; circumstance, he said, is either something you describe or the only word that means both a condition and money. She said the money is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ circumstance had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the witness. The ⑧ circumstance of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pages and eleven years of describing; circumstance, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ circumstance I remember is the one at the end, which was described in 1971 and is still described as the poorest in the county. A ⑩ circumstance, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being described; every circumstance, she said, is money that has agreed to look like a condition. She said the money was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 情形（指那种状况本身，与那件事相对）
C. 固定搭配：describe a circumstance 描述一种情形
D. n. 情形（指那桩案子里每一种）
E. n. 情形（指末尾那一种）
F. n. 家境（抽象：它承载的那份家底）
G. n. 那份家底（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The circumstance, meaning the condition and not the event
circumstance was the whole of the family
the circumstance had become a number in a report
The circumstance of the whole thing
A circumstance, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: describe a circumstance 意为“描述一种情形”，1951 年母亲被派去描述她改变不了的那种情形。
circumstance 意为“情形、情况”，指那种状况本身而不是那件事，共九页，由最后来的人描述。
circumstance 指那桩案子里每一种情形，每一种都是同样的证人。
circumstance 指末尾那一种（律师保留的那一种），是唯一有人认真描述过的。
circumstance 意为“家境”，抽象指它承载的那份家底，父亲说 circumstance 就是那个家的全部。
circumstance 为抽象用法，指那份家底本身，是一个家里人人都注意到、却没人质疑的东西。
circumstance 意为“情形、情况”，到 1966 年这种 circumstance 成了报告里的一个数字。
circumstance 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九页纸和十一年的描述。
circumstance 意为“情形”，我记得的是末尾那一种，1971 年描述过，至今仍被说成全县最窘迫的。
circumstance 为抽象总称，祖母说一种情形是唯一会因为被认真描述而变好的东西。
